License under Apache-2.0 and add cleanlanguage/ licence copies (#279)

Make Apache-2.0 the licence of the whole project, as the maintainer
decided, starting with the legal texts. This is unit 1 of 3 of TODO 243.

LICENSE holds the Apache License, Version 2.0 text byte for byte, with
no project header. NOTICE.md carries the copyright, the scope and the
suggested attribution under Apache-2.0, and states that the vendored
AIQT pack, which ships no licence file of its own, is covered by the
Apache-2.0 text in LICENSE, as the coordinator ruling requires. Its
scope section says that the notice also ships in the skill zip and the
plugin, and that the paths it names, apart from the baseline's own
tools/card-fonts/, are paths of the source repository. README.md names
Apache-2.0, points to LICENSE and gives the suggested attribution, and
its sentence on the canonical skill definition now gives that quantity
as a numeral.

While this change was open, main added to NOTICE.md a new section,
"Recommended, not embedded: AIQT", after the paragraph under Adopted
governance rules, the paragraph to which this change adds the sentence
on the AIQT pack's licence. The branch merged main, and git reported a
conflict only in NOTICE.md, at that paragraph. The resolution keeps
both this change's sentence and main's section. cleanlanguage/NOTICE.md
copies the merged NOTICE.md, main's section included, because
tools/check-agent-plugin-manifest.py requires the 2 files to be
byte-equal.

Main then changed tools/release-package.sh to lay out and check the
package in a work folder in dist/ and to move the zips and their
.sha256 files into dist/ only after every check passes (#273). The
branch merged main again, and git reported a conflict only in that
file. The resolution keeps main's work folder and this change's
licence copies: LICENSE and NOTICE.md reach src/ of the work folder
from cleanlanguage/ through git archive, so main's lines that wrote the
root files there with git show, and its chmod 644 of them, are gone;
the find that sets every file there to 0644 still covers both. Main's
tools/test-release-package-dist.py builds a reference zip with the
packager of its REFERENCE_COMMIT, which predates the copies: its
allowlist refuses them, and its expected entry list would list LICENSE
and NOTICE.md twice. The test now adapts that packager with 2 edits to
its text, each of which must match exactly once: the allowlist admits
the 2 paths, and the expected entry list drops them from the entries of
the git tree. REFERENCE_COMMIT stays, since for 1 tree the packager
under test zips the same bytes as the adapted reference packager: the
set-up builds the clone's 1 tree with the adapted reference packager,
and case 1 builds that tree with the packager under test and requires
the digest of the set-up's build. Case 1 does not compare trees: a zip
built from this change's tree differs from one built from main's, at
least in its LICENSE and NOTICE.md entries, since this change rewrites
the root files that those entries copy.

This squash message replaces every commit message on the branch when
the pull request merges. Where an earlier commit message differs from
the pull request description or this squash message, those 2 are the
record.

After the second merge, the branch has 9 single-parent commits. The
last adds only .github/squash/279.txt, byte for byte equal to this
message, as the committed input that the Pull request text gate reads.
The recorded failure reported that the file was missing and reported
0 text defects. The coordinator check and a green text gate are still
required before merge, with no further QA review, as the maintainer
decided in Entry 165.

The site's licence page names the notice file as the place of the
suggested attribution and gives it as NOTICE.md does. Its modified
date in site-src/site.json moves from 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-18, the
day of that change, since tools/check-page-metadata.py fails a page
whose article:modified_time is more than 7 days older than the last
commit of the page's file. Regenerating changes 3 lines of
site/license/index.html (the suggested-attribution line, the
article:modified_time and the JSON-LD dateModified) and 1 line of
site/sitemap.xml (the lastmod of /license/). No other generated line
changes.

cleanlanguage/LICENSE and cleanlanguage/NOTICE.md are new byte-equal
copies of the root files, as the maintainer decided in Entry 74, so the
skill zip and the plugin, which installs the cleanlanguage/ tree, both
carry them. tools/release-package.sh accepts the 2 paths, fails unless
each copy has the same git blob as its root file, and stages the zip's
LICENSE and NOTICE.md from cleanlanguage/; the zip still holds each
once, at its root, and the expected entry list and the byte check read
them from the cleanlanguage/ blobs. Its comments now give as numerals
11 quantities that they gave in words. The gate
tools/check-agent-plugin-manifest.py fails when a copy is missing, is a
symlink, is not a regular file (a FIFO, a folder, a socket or a
device) or differs from its root file. It reads a copy only after
those refusals, and asks for a copy's type only through pathlib's
is_symlink, exists and is_file, which call os.lstat and os.stat. It
does not refuse a root LICENSE or NOTICE.md that is a symlink: it
reads it through the link, which the tests pin, while
tools/release-package.sh compares the git blobs at HEAD, and the blob
of a symlink holds the path it leads to, so a root file that is a
symlink to a file equal to the copy passes the gate but fails the
packager's comparison, and one that leads to a different file fails
both. The gate's code adds the tuple LICENCE_FILES, which names the 2
root files, the function read_bytes, which reads a file and ends with
exit 3 when it cannot, and the function check_licence_copies, which
main calls after the marketplace check and before its success line,
which now also says that the 2 copies equal the root files; no other
line of its code changes. Its module docstring now gives 1 quantity as
a numeral. It also says how the tests check the refusals: they answer
os.stat and os.lstat for 1 copy and require no open, read or listing
of the copy before the refusal through a call that they record. It
names 2 residuals, as given below: a gate that asks for a file type
another way, and a read before the refusal through a route that the
tests do not record, which the seam does not catch. The header of the
Agent Plugins manifest workflow says that its job also checks the
copies.

tools/test-skill-version-consumers.py builds the package with a copy at
HEAD that is missing, has 1 byte replaced, has CR LF line endings, has
the case of its letters swapped, has 1 space before its first line
ending or after its last, or has 1 LF added at its end or its final LF
removed, for each file, and requires exit 1 with that copy's message.
A table adds 16 rows for each file: for each copy and each root file,
and for the index and for the working-tree files, the place differs or
is missing while HEAD is good, which must build, and HEAD differs or is
missing while the place is good, which must fail. A last case, for each
file, commits a .gitattributes giving the copy text eol=crlf, so git
archive writes its zip entry with CR LF while the blobs keep LF, and
requires exit 1 with the byte check's message for that entry. Its
module docstring now gives as numerals 3 quantities that it gave in
words, and its comments 2 more.

tools/test-agent-plugin-manifest.py tests the refusal of each kind of
copy on every runner, with no skip, through the route by which the
gate asks for a file type: a fake answers os.stat and os.lstat, called
with the exact path string of 1 copy and no dir_fd, with the type of
the kind under test, while the file behind it stays a regular, equal
copy, and records each call of io.open, open, os.open, os.listdir or
os.scandir whose path argument is that exact string, with or without
a dir_fd, and that looks that name up on io, builtins or os at the
time of the call. For each file and each of 11 kinds (a symlink to a
regular file, to a FIFO or to a character device, a dangling symlink,
a missing copy, a folder, a FIFO, a socket, a character device, a block
device and a type that Linux does not use), the gate must exit 1 with
that kind's message, and the fake must have recorded no open, read or
listing of the copy before the refusal; a gate that reads the copy
before refusing it through a route that the fake does not record passes
that case, as the residuals below say. A control requires that a
regular type through the fake passes, that the fake answered and that
the gate read the copy. A seam case gives a root file the type of a
symlink and requires that it be read through. A case tests make_node's
policy: skip on EPERM, EACCES,
EOPNOTSUPP or ENOSYS, which the case names itself, with a message
equal to the one that names the kind of node, its path and the error,
for a test node at cleanlanguage/node and for a FIFO at LICENSE.fifo
in the fixture root, and raise, not skip, on each error of a fixed
set: an OSError with a message and a path for each other errno that
the errno module names (ENOSPC, EINVAL and EROFS among them) and for
the number 1 above the highest it names; 1 OSError with no errno,
whose message is "AF_UNIX path too long", which Python raises for a
socket path too long for a socket address; and 1 ValueError, whose
message is "embedded null character in path". A skip on any error of
that set fails the case.

A sweep makes each 1-byte edit of a copy (a space, a CR or an LF
inserted, 1 byte deleted, a letter put in the other case or another
byte replaced by x or y) at every offset of the fixture texts; in the
real LICENSE and NOTICE.md it makes the replacement at every offset,
and each edit at offset 0, at the last byte and at the end. The gate
must refuse each with exit 1 and the differs message.

Real-node smoke cases make, where the OS allows it, a copy that is a
symlink to the root file, to a FIFO or to nothing, a FIFO, a Unix
socket or a character device, and a root file that is a symlink; each
checks that the node has the type the fake gives that kind, and runs
the gate. A FIFO copy, or a link to one, is checked in a separate
process that must exit 1 within 10 seconds while a thread waits to
open the FIFO for writing, so a gate that opens the FIFO for reading
before refusing the copy, with or without blocking, fails. Where the
OS refuses a node with 1 of those 4 errors, the smoke case or subtest
skips with a message that names the kind of node, its path and the
error, and the seam still tests that kind; any other error makes it
error. unittest counts a skip as skipped, not as failed, so such a run
ends with OK (skipped=N) and exit 0 when nothing else fails, and the
script then prints unittest's own record of each skip, whose test id
carries the subtest's parameters. In an unprivileged run the 2 device
subtests skip. The suite fails each of 13 mutants of the gate's
refusal logic, each of 6 mutants of make_node's skip policy and each
of 5 mutants of its skip message (without the path, without the kind,
with only the error's strerror text, always naming a test node, or
always putting cleanlanguage/ before the file name), both on this
runner and with every kind of node refused.

Residuals, each with any case that catches part of it: a gate that
asks for a file type other than through os.stat or os.lstat looked up
when called, which fails the refusal subtests for each kind that the
changed query refuses, and the control when the gate no longer calls
os.lstat, or no longer calls os.stat, with the exact path string, a
false alarm until the fake follows it, never a silent pass; a read
before the refusal through io.FileIO, a bytes path, another spelling of
the path, such as one relative to a dir_fd, a reference to 1 of the 5
recorded functions taken before the fake is in place, such as a name
bound at import, the same function reached through another module,
such as posix.open, a subprocess or ctypes, which the seam does not
catch, since the fake records only a call whose path argument is the
exact path string, with or without a dir_fd, and that looks the
function's name up on io, builtins or os at the time of the call: the
FIFO smoke cases catch it where a FIFO can be made, and the cases for a
missing copy and for a folder on every runner, and the smoke cases for
a socket and for a dangling symlink where those can be made, catch one
that lets through an error that it meets on that copy, so when every
kind of node is refused, one that lets no such error through passes
every case, such as one that ignores the errors of its open and of its
read, or one that ignores the error of its open when its open of a
folder fails, as that of io.FileIO does; a gate that finds a root
symlink other than through os.stat or os.lstat called with the exact
path string and no dir_fd, which are the only calls the fake answers,
such as through os.readlink, a call with a dir_fd, or os.stat, os.lstat
or os.path.islink of a bytes path or of another spelling of the path,
which only the real-node case catches, where symlinks can be made; any
part of the fake's stat result other than its type bits, since the
gate reads only those: a fake with other permission bits than 0o777
for a symlink and 0o644 for any other type, or with other values in
the fields it takes from the real file, passes; a make_node that skips
only on an error outside the fixed set that the skip-policy case tries,
such as another errno number that the errno module does not name, an
OSError with no errno and another message, an OSError with an errno of
the set but no path, a ValueError with another message, or another
exception that is not an OSError (a mutant of make_node for each of
those 5 passes the suite); on a runner that refuses a kind of node,
whether the fake describes that kind as the kernel does, and for a
block device on every unprivileged run, and a character device
without the CAP_MKNOD capability; the deletion of the lines that print
the skip records, though unittest's summary still reads skipped=N; a
Python release other than 3.14.4, the only one run, that reaches a
file's type another way, which fails closed; timing and flakiness,
which no repeated run of a mutant measured; a comparison
loose only for some edits of 2 or more bytes that no case makes, such
as 2 bytes replaced at the same length (one loose for every such edit
fails each case that makes a copy and its root file differ by more than
1 byte, the real-node one where symlinks can be made), for 1-byte
edits the sweep does not make, or for a 1-byte
insertion or deletion inside the real files at a byte pattern absent
from the fixtures; a prefix comparison longer than the real file; a
packager comparison that ignores another difference, such as a blank
line added between 2 lines (one that ignores every blank line, as
diff -B does, fails the subtests that add a final LF to a copy); in
the FIFO smoke cases, an open that the writer thread misses because it
came before the thread began to wait or was not recorded within 0.2
seconds; and a correct gate slower than 10 seconds on a FIFO copy,
which fails its case.

Landing the legal texts first makes every later statement that the
licence text is in LICENSE true when it lands. Units 2 and 3 follow:
unit 2 changes the skill, the plugin manifests and the portable
renderings, and the licence line of the test input in
tools/test-skill-release-date.py, which copies the skill's header, and
regenerates the site's instructions page, which embeds the skill;
unit 3 changes the rest of the site, including the rest of the licence
page, which it rewrites, setting the page's modified date in
site-src/site.json again.

Places that still name CC BY-SA 4.0, the earlier licence, as the
licence of the project or the site remain in the tree; this change
leaves them as they are, and units 2 and 3 change those places. The
search for them is this command, which counts, in each tracked file,
the lines that hold any of the 3 terms in any letter case:

    git grep -c -i -E 'BY-SA|ShareAlike|Creative Commons'

The run recorded for the preceding commit counted 56 lines in 34 files.
The new squash file adds 3 matching lines in 1 file, so the expected
total is 59 lines in 35 files. This total is inferred from the recorded
count and the draft file, not a new run of git grep. The lines counted
also include lines that name Creative Commons but not as this
project's licence, which stay as they are. A line that names the
earlier licence in another spelling, which that search does not find,
is a residual that no check of this change covers. The release is
TODO 244.
